title: How I Built an AI Agency from $0 to $100K in 12 Months (Full Roadmap)
summary: An AI automation agency owner's roadmap to $100K: learn Make.com from YouTube, land a first client through the warm network, then LinkedIn content, DMs and paid audits; pitches his mentorship.

assertions.quote: made over six figures, and was lucky enough to work with over 50 businesses across the world for my AI automation agency
delivering for those clients to be able to make 10K a month, about 100K with my agency

verdicts.note: Agency success stories are survivors; most new service businesses earn little in their first year and agency-course audiences crowd the same market.

assertions.quote: I spent about two weeks, I'd say, learning the skill like watching videos on YouTube, which is pretty much all the time that you need

verdicts.note: No-code tools are quick to learn for simple workflows, but reliable client systems and selling them take longer for most beginners.

assertions.quote: reach out to everybody that you know and ask them if they know someone cuz most likely you don't know business owners

verdicts.note: Warm-network referrals are a common source of first clients, but results depend heavily on the network and are not reliable for everyone.

assertions.quote: working for free for your first few customers is the smartest move that you can do instead of charging

verdicts.note: Free work can buy testimonials and experience, but it also attracts low-commitment clients and does not reliably convert to paid work.

assertions.quote: I was doing it for free to start, but then I charged about 300 for an hour and then more
I don't know why after 6 months they've made no money. It's because you're unfocused
you do now, which is obviously great cuz you want to learn, you can learn faster
